stopRootCause.author: Balance writer placed UI-owned inputs in BALANCE_DESIGN.json, despite semantic movement requirements already being available in prose / outputs.
stopRootCause.reviewer: Inspect finding f6 acknowledges the exact deterministic error but marks it follow-up, neededBefore implementation, rather than a current release blocker.
stopRootCause.host: project-delivery.ts sends Inspect to Revise only when reviewer reports blockers. With only follow-ups, the deterministic release gate stops the run; the batch's available revision pass is never scheduled.
stopRootCause.classification: LLM author / reviewer execution mistakes plus a system orchestration design defect: deterministic repair routing depends on semantic severity classification.
stopRootCause.positiveBoundary: The host correctly did not release invalid input; no false gate pass and no automatic extra paid loop.

sources.section: basket traversal table and passed check

independentSemanticFindings.finding: spawnInterval/(1-clutterRatio) is an average-type interval, not a minimum spacing of consecutive randomly generated fruit. The claimed guarantee that alternating-edge fruits never force a miss is unsupported.

counterexample.basis: Independent arithmetic from saved scheduling formula and saved model's speed-at-spawn / 66 px horizontal contact rule; no product model execution or mutation.

independentSemanticFindings.impact: Downstream would consume a false deterministic fairness guarantee and an invalid acceptance expectation.
independentSemanticFindings.limit: This does not prove the game is unwinnable; its allowance for missed fruit and a single seeded successful path are different claims.

independentSemanticFindings.finding: Pause freezes active L7 effects, but acceptance says no effects / shake / stains / vignette remain after pause. Pausing during an active effect cannot satisfy both.
independentSemanticFindings.impact: If UI includes pause, implementation and acceptance must guess whether to retain a frozen effect or clear it.
independentSemanticFindings.limit: Pause is not yet selected by the UI owner; this is a conditional existing-contract conflict, not a demand to add pause.

independentSemanticFindings.finding: rAF timestamps are declared milliseconds, dt is declared seconds, but the literal dt formula omits conversion by 1000 before comparing to the 0.1 second cap.
independentSemanticFindings.impact: Literal implementation would cap a normal 16.7 ms frame at 0.1 s; the intended units are inferable but the written formula is not execution-safe.
independentSemanticFindings.limit: Technical baseline is awaiting a final owner completion; this must be closed before implementation, not treated as a proven runtime bug.

conclusion: Partial execution improvements, not successful overall acceptance or cost optimization. The run reached fewer documents than the previous paid benchmark; a smaller total is not evidence of savings. Repeated per-document tool turns remain expensive and semantic review misses persist.
nextSystemWorkProposal: Separate known deterministic repair routing from LLM blocker/follow-up classification, reusing the existing one revision pass rather than adding another review stage.
Correct the demonstrated author permission false-positive for actual checker invocations; do not broaden into a generic shell parser or change product artifacts.
Reduce invalid format discovery and scattered unchanged checks with the smallest existing tool-interface improvement.
Re-examine why optional derivation claims grew into a long model-debugging task; require evidence proportionate to necessary downstream decisions, not universal fairness or extra simulations.
